title: Human brain mapping and brain decoding. | Jack Gallant | TEDxSanFrancisco
summary: Berkeley neuroscientist Jack Gallant shows how fMRI brain mapping can be used to decode what a person sees, with visualizations of brain activity and its implications.
why: HN cites it in discussions of reconstructing images from brain scans and the ethics of future brain reading.
